title: openai-compat: tool_choice semantics + schema mapping + tool message formatting
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation:
We need the OpenAI-compat layer to more closely match recent OpenAI semantics for function/tool calling: (1) map incoming tool schemas to our internal tool descriptors so tooling and validation can reuse existing runtime checks, (2) implement explicit `tool_choice` semantics so assistant responses that choose a tool (without invoking it) are surfaced and routed correctly, and (3) normalize tool/assistant->tool message formatting for downstream consumers (console, logs, and Dedicated routing).

This PR implements schema mapping helpers, updates the compat runtime to emit `tool_choice` messages (with the same ambient metadata OpenAI uses), and adjusts message formatting for both `tool` calls and `tool_choice` events so our Console and the OpenAI-compat tests see consistent payloads. Also included: unit + integration tests, docs updates, and a migration note for integrators.

What changed (summary):
- add openai_compat/schema_mapper to translate OpenAI-style JSON Schema/tool descriptors into redwood tool descriptors (types, required/optional mapping, example coercion helpers).
- update openai_compat/runtime to: 1) detect assistant tool-choice intents (assistant message with `tool_choice` intent), 2) emit an explicit `tool_choice` event when assistant chooses a tool without immediately invoking it, and 3) preserve tool metadata (name/version/schema_id) on subsequent tool call messages so routing/fallbacks can find compatible variants.
- unify tool message formatting: tool calls are now emitted with a top-level `tool` object: {name, args_serialized, schema_id, schema_hash}, and `tool_choice` messages are emitted with {name, reason, match_score, suggested_args} where suggested_args is a JSON string for deterministic downstream parsing.
- tests: add compat/unit/test_schema_mapper.py, compat/integration/test_tool_choice_flow.py, fixtures for OpenAI-style tool descriptors.
- docs: redwood-docs/openai-compat.md updated with examples and migration guidance.
- minor rework of Console parser to accept both old and new message shapes for a 1-release compatibility window.

Checklist (high level):
- [x] Schema mapper implementation and unit tests
- [x] Runtime changes to surface `tool_choice` events
- [x] Message formatting changes + console compatibility shim
- [x] Integration tests for a full assistant -> tool_choice -> tool_call flow
- [x] Docs and migration note

Related work: Linear ENG-3245 (tooling + compat), ENG-3312 (console parsing followup).

Notes on compatibility/migration:
- We keep the old message shape accepted by Console for two releases. New consumers should switch to the normalized `tool` and `tool_choice` fields.
- The schema_mapper exposes a stable function openai_schema_to_tool_descriptor(schema) that returns typed fields; this API is considered experimental for one release while we monitor edge cases.

Merges & CI: initial CI run failed due to a flaky integration test (race in integration/test_tool_choice_flow.py asserting ordering), fixed by adding deterministic sequencing in the runtime test harness. All checks passed on the final run.

Files changed (high level):
- packages/openai-compat/src/schema_mapper.py
- packages/openai-compat/src/runtime.py
- packages/openai-compat/tests/test_schema_mapper.py
- packages/openai-compat/tests/test_tool_choice_flow.py
- packages/console/src/parsers/tool_messages.ts (compat shim)
- redwood-docs/openai-compat.md
- packages/openai-compat/CHANGELOG.md
- packages/openai-compat/__init__.py
- packages/openai-compat/fixtures/openai_tool_descriptors.json

review_conversation: Diego Martínez: Overall looks good. Two requests: add an explicit test for schema with `anyOf` and make sure schema_mapper preserves 'examples' arrays.
Asha Patel: Added `anyOf` handling and propagated examples into suggested_args in the latest commit (1a9f3d2 -> 3b2c7e8).

Maya Chen: Can you clarify the ordering guarantees for tool_choice -> tool call when the agent both suggests args and immediately invokes the tool? We should avoid double-processing in the Dedicated router.

Asha Patel: The runtime now emits a `tool_choice` with a `invocation_hint` flag. If the agent intends to invoke immediately we set invocation_hint=true and the router will prefer the accompanying tool call; otherwise router treats them as separate events. Tests added. (7d4a0bf)
Liam O'Connor: CI failure looked like a test race; the fix is reasonable. Approving after green CI.
Maya Chen: Approved after docs update.
release_notes: OpenAI compatibility: add schema mapping for tools, emit explicit tool_choice events, and normalize tool message formatting. Backwards compatibility shim included for Console for one release. Integrators should update to use the normalized `tool` and `tool_choice` fields.
